review:
Fiesta Clusters celebrates two Mexican holidays on a 7x7 grid: Cinco de Mayo in the base game and Día de Muertos in free spins. Five or more adjacent matching symbols pay and are replaced by refills, which continue as long as wins keep forming.

Surprise progressive multipliers can attach to winning combinations in the base game. Three or more sugar-skull scatters open the Día de Muertos bonus, which adds even more multiplier action. BGaming rates the game very high volatility with a 5,000x maximum, and the 97% RTP is excellent. Free spins arrive about once every 269 spins. The two-holiday theme gives the base game and bonus distinct looks.
